lead: A `Core` member whose call site writes a type argument is never credited by a call, so `dossier.py` reports `tests 0 case(s)` over cases that plainly pin it.
body: The detector matches `Core\Arr::shapeAs(` and the source reads `Core\Arr::shapeAs<{n: int}>(`, so three green conformance cases went uncounted and the member read as owing both its tests. Grep `tests/` for the member before writing anything, and where the claim is already pinned the whole edit is `// covers: <the member>` on one `.nvst` and one Rust `#[test]`.
